translations.web: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.
translations.bsb: Some of their Kohathite relatives were responsible for preparing the rows of the showbread every Sabbath.
translations.kjv: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
